scope: Eight resource changes in the working tree based on this parent; source invariants also compare with the chat's starting commit.

tile_accounting.regression: server/test/maps-budget-cache.test.mjs: tile-only traffic retains useful client counters without loading matching-attempt metadata
tile_accounting.limits: Synthetic uncached tile accounting, including initialization and maintenance. No provider credits or production traffic. Does not establish fleet capacity or whole-request CPU/latency. Admitted-request writes and quota caps are unchanged.

boundary_dataset_refresh.fixture: Load two ADM1 datasets, expire/refresh the second, revisit the still-valid first, reject a point outside its geometry.

account_refresh.change: Reload/decrypt and check the current token, then skip encryption/preferences only when the updated Session equals the current Session.
account_refresh.device_regression_local: APK compiled; not executed locally. Emulator/device CI is required.
account_refresh.guards: No plaintext cache. Actual saves retain fresh IVs; old-token and stale-profile protections remain.

exploration_cache.fixture: Fill 4096 unique cells, add one new cell, revisit 100 recent cells.
exploration_cache.concurrency_fixture: Four threads, 5000 operations per thread, capacity 64, with write-failure removal and retry.
exploration_cache.limits: Counts candidate submissions in the turnover fixture, not a fleet rate. Eviction never removes persisted exploration. Existing database validation and idempotence remain.

overlay_cancellation.change: Check existing generation/destroy guards before queued SQL, between cached-place reads and before polygon conversion.
overlay_cancellation.limits: Current polygons, source coordinates and detail are unchanged. Already-running individual SQL/cache/conversion operations may still finish. No CPU/latency percentage measured.

retired_overlay_cache.guards: Fixture preserves a readable current polygon and unrelated file; repeats cleanup through explicit cache clearing.
retired_overlay_cache.limits: Actual reclaimed storage depends on retired files present. No real-phone storage amount measured.

snapshot_and_restore.change: Reuse one cleared ContentValues buffer per table instead of one new buffer per row.
snapshot_and_restore.guards: Synchronous insert binding; every cursor column assigned on every row; transaction, schema, values and formats unchanged.
snapshot_and_restore.validation: Existing export/import, CSV and roundtrip tests included in complete Android suite.
snapshot_and_restore.limits: Allocation reduction follows code structure. No heap, CPU or battery percentage benchmark.

assertions: Compacted page count less than half of populated page count
Deletion marker cleared and stale repository generation invalidated
Fresh repository records new history successfully
explicit_deletion_compaction.tradeoff: Explicit deletion may take longer and VACUUM can need temporary disk space. Busy/low-space compaction failure does not undo or fail committed deletion. Active snapshots can defer WAL truncation. No driving/startup/periodic compaction and no forensic flash-deletion claim.

accuracy_source_audit.limits: Source invariants and regression checks do not establish accuracy parity on every physical drive.

limits: No physical-device battery, whole-app performance, fleet DAU or driving-hours increase measured. Android and gateway changes require their respective build/deployment.
